name: harness

harness.description: Compose a model request for a session: {op: context|compact|inspect|injection|ring, session?, descriptors?} -> {system, messages, tools} (injection: {system, tools, max_bytes}; ring: a sweep report).

harness.selftest.description: Contract: the frame renders and one record projects, with no dependency in the way.

harness.integration.description: Contract: the memo cartridge composes a template for {cwd?}.

description: Builds model context from memos, session history, terminal state, budgets, and memory.

system.doc: Base system prompt text, prepended unframed.

roster.doc: The roster source: an actor, the environment variable holding its credential, and that fetch's own row, byte and deadline caps. The base clears a node's environment, so that variable's name must start `HARNESS_ROSTER_` — the prefix this cartridge declares in `grant.env`. Absent means no roster.

clock.doc: Injected key returning the current date. Empty resolves the UTC date natively, fresh on every request. A key named here must be an event some cartridge in the composition listens to.

environment.doc: Host-scan key rendered as `environment`; empty leaves the placeholder blank. A key named here must be an event some cartridge in the composition listens to.

terminal.doc: Wrapped-shell key whose `commands` op is rendered as `terminal`; empty leaves the placeholder blank.

memory.doc: Memory-bank key distilled prose is ingested into; empty disables eviction. A key named here must be an event some cartridge in the composition listens to.

max_bytes.doc: Request budget. Two consumers read this one number: on the context op it is the ceiling that triggers compaction, and the proxy treats it as the point past which it stops adding retrieved context to a launched agent's request. That history is the agent's own and nothing on this side can compact it, so setting it low costs a long conversation its recall rather than refusing it. proxy.max_bytes is the only wall.

output_headroom.doc: Output bytes reserved out of that budget.

keep_turns.doc: Complete turns kept at the tail of a compacted projection.

compact_after_messages.doc: Messages after which working memory is refreshed, independently of the provider's context window.

compact_after_bytes.doc: Context bytes after which the same happens.

ring_keep.doc: Finished turns whose files stay on disk as hard reference. `{op:"ring"}` distills older ones into the memory bank and drops their files. Zero keeps every turn forever.

ring_sweep.doc: Turns distilled per sweep, so one sweep costs a bounded number of summarization requests and a long backlog drains over several sweeps.

slim.doc: Distil a failed tool-using run named on the ring call into one memory line; false stores nothing.

limits.instruction_bytes.doc: Bytes one instruction file may contribute.

limits.instructions_bytes.doc: Bytes every instruction file may contribute together.

limits.noticed_problems.doc: Problems named in a composition notice before it says how many are left.

limits.names_bytes.doc: Bytes of a name listing rendered into a prompt.

limits.terminal_output_bytes.doc: Bytes of terminal output carried into a prompt, taken from its tail.

limits.roster_evidence_bytes.doc: Bytes of roster evidence one composition renders. Bounds the rendered rows, not the fetch: `roster.max_bytes` bounds that.

verify.description: Sends the selftest and integration contracts on the real base.
